paragraphs: The M6 Convertible has been part of the BMW 6 Series range since 2012, representing the convertible body style of the F-generation M6. The F12 M6 Convertible uses the S63 — a 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 that was the high-performance flagship of the 6 Series range during its production run. The S63 is the M-division's version of the N63 hot-vee V8, with different turbos and calibration, and it shares the same fundamental architecture across the M5 and M6 of that generation. The M6 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
